**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (confidence 0.9)**

- **Investigation:** Full-document searches for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate" and "workers' compensation" returned no hits. I read both candidate sections: § 13 is an IP indemnity only, and § 20 (General Matters) runs (a)–(j) across p0135–p0149 covering notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law, headings and entire agreement — no insurance covenant anywhere.
- **Risk:** Garman personnel attend Authorized Locations for installation, data conversion and training and handle Sparkling data, which is walk-away territory under the rule for an uninsured vendor.
- **Cure:** A single `insert_after` p0149 adding § 20(k) at the preferred level, carrying all six preferred elements in one sentence pair (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber/privacy 5M where Sparkling data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). The cyber trigger is drafted to reach any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Sparkling rather than named examples. I omitted at-own-expense and one-year survival tails as non-element boilerplate, and left all existing subsections verbatim; the fallback (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) is offered in the comment.
